name: toolpin community trust registry (seed)
notes: Entries are community-contributed attestations about specific MCP servers.
This seed ships empty on purpose: an unverified allow/deny list is worse than none.
Add your own with `toolpin trust --add`, or point at a shared file with --registry.
Indicators below are heuristics about launch configuration, not claims about any package.

indicators.reason: Server is launched from a raw file URL, which the publisher can change at any time without a release.
Launch configuration hides its real destination behind a URL shortener.
Launch command decodes or evaluates an inline payload; a server's entry point has no reason to be obfuscated.
